chunks: And by his chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Seal the doors that open into the mosque, except for the door of Ali (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: Which door was exempt from being sealed in the mosque according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, underscores the unique spiritual and physical proximity of Imam Ali (a.s.) to the Prophet’s sanctuary, symbolizing his exclusive right to leadership and closeness to divine knowledge. The sealing of other doors while leaving Ali’s open serves as a tangible metaphor for his singular status among the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the concept of Wilayah within the domestic and sacred spaces of Medina.
